title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) placed on IR
items.desc: The Buccaneers placed WR Jalen McMillan on injured reserve.
items.impact: McMillan underwent an MRI that confirmed a PCL sprain. He is expected to miss 6-to-8 weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) listed as 'DNP' on Monday's estimated practice report
items.desc: Rico Dowdle is listed as a DNP on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Dowdle was sidelined this past week. He is likely to remain sidelined for the Steelers on a short week against the Browns. Jaylen Warren would remain the clear lead back for Pittsburgh.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elgton Jenkins (concussion) listed as DNP on Monday's practice report
items.desc: Browns OL Elgton Jenkins was listed as "DNP" on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: It is a short week for Cleveland playing its division rival Steelers on Thursday. The status of Jenkins will need to be monitored the next couple of days.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Teven Jenkins (back) listed as DNP on Monday's estimated practice report
items.desc: Browns OL Teven Jenkins was listed as "DNP" on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: It is a short week for Cleveland playing its division rival Steelers on Thursday. The status of Jenkins will need to be monitored the next couple of days.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colby Parkinson (AC sprain) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Rams TE Colby Parkinson is considered day-to-day with an AC sprain.
items.impact: Parkinson suffered the injury in Sunday's loss against the Broncos. Terrance Ferguson is also likely to miss Week 4 due to an ankle injury. Tyler Higbee could be in line for an increased role for the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) to likely miss Week 4
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said TE Terrance Ferguson will likely miss Week 4 against the Eagles.
items.impact: Ferguson left Sunday's game against the Broncos. He did return, but then left again after making one catch. With Colby Parkinson also banged up, Tyler Higbee could be in line for a bigger role.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyson Bagent (concussion) active for Week 3
items.desc: Tyson Bagent (concussion) is active for the Chicago Bears against the Philadelphia Eagles according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Bagent will suit up after clearing through concussion protocol at the end of last week, likely backing up veteran signal-caller Case Keenum against the Eagles for head coach Ben Johnson Monday night.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Puka Nacua (groin) 'hopeful' to play in Week 4
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said he was "hopeful" WR Puka Nacua will be able to play in Week 4 against the Eagles.
items.impact: Adam Schefter reported Sunday morning that the Rams do not believe surgery will be needed, but it's still on the table. Nacua will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandin Echols placed in concussion protocol
items.desc: Steelers CB Brandin Echols has entered the league's concussion protocol.
items.impact: Echols was injured in Week 3's win over the Bengals. He will almost certainly be sidelined this week with the Steelers playing on Thursday against the Browns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) seen in sling during practice Monday
items.desc: Steelers DB Jalen Ramsey was spotted in a sling at Monday's practice.
items.impact: It appears to be a new injury for Ramsey. His status will need to be monitored in practice ahead of Thursday's game against the Browns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Fernando Carmona Jr. (ankle) to miss a few weeks
items.desc: Titans OG Fernando Carmona "will miss a few weeks" after suffering a sprained ankle in Week 3's loss to the Giants.
items.impact: Carmona, a fifth-round rookie, has started all three games for the Titans. He was injured on the first offensive snap of Sunday's loss and will miss some time as a result.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Phidarian Mathis activated by Bills
items.desc: The Bills activated DT Phidarian Mathis from the reserve/suspended list.
items.impact: Mathis has finished serving out his three-game suspension for violating the league's substance abuse policy. He could make his season debut in Week 4.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ollie Gordon II: All RBs on Dolphins 'are going to have their roles'
items.desc: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said all running backs on the roster are "going to have their roles."
items.impact: Gordon remains the most likely player to lead the backfield, but Jaylen Wright will figure to have a role when he is healthy. Gordon can be viewed as a borderline RB2 for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Romello Height (hand) hopeful to return in Week 4
items.desc: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan said he hopes that Romello Height is back against the Broncos.
items.impact: Height was sidelined this past week after going down with a hand injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dre Greenlaw (quad) to be monitored this week
items.desc: 49ers LB Dre Greenlaw will be monitored in practice this week.
items.impact: Greenlaw suffered the injury in Sunday's win over the Cardinals. His status is up in the air heading into Week 4 against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent Williams (stinger) to be monitored this week
items.desc: 49ers LT Trent Williams will be monitored in practice this week.
items.impact: Williams was carted off the field from Sunday's win over the Cardinals. He appears to have avoided a serious injury, but his status is up in the air for Week 4.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jake Haener waived by Giants
items.desc: The Giants waived QB Jake Haener.
items.impact: This is the corresponding move to the Giants trading for J.J. McCarthy. Haener is expected to re-sign with the Giants practice squad.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Bech (forearm) to miss some time
items.desc: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said WR Jack Bech is expected to be out for a "little bit" with a fractured forearm.
items.impact: Kubiak added that the team has yet to make a roster decision. He could be placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Ertz elevated from Eagles practice squad Monday
items.desc: The Eagles elevated TE Zach Ertz from their practice squad for Monday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Ertz returned to the Eagles last week after Dallas Goedert (knee) went down. Ertz should be involved, but he's a wait-and-see for now for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Evans (rib) considered day-to-day
items.desc: 49ers WR Mike Evans is considered day-to-day with a rib strain.
items.impact: It is a positive update for Evans after he was carted off the field during Sunday's win over the Cardinals. His status remains up in the air for Week 4, but it appears he avoided anything too serious.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bucky Irving 'not on injury report' after Week 3
items.desc: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said Bucky Irving "is not on the team's injury report" after Week 3.
items.impact: Irving spent the majority of the fourth quarter on Sunday on the sideline. It was unclear if it was related to an injury, but it appears it wasn't. He should be back in his lead role in Week 4.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) to miss extended time
items.desc: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Travis Etienne Jr. "will miss time."
items.impact: Etienne does not hold a clear timetable to return. Alvin Kamara should take on a bigger role in the Saints backfield with Kendre Miller also taking on a bigger role behind him.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jayden Daniels (elbow) to practice this week
items.desc: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Jayden Daniels will travel with the team to London and practice in "some capacity this week."
items.impact: Daniels was not placed on injured reserve, meaning he is expected to miss less than four weeks. He is unlikely to return this week, but a return in Week 5 or 6 could be in play.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jovaughn Gwyn (ankle) expected to miss multiple weeks
items.desc: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said C Jovaughn Gwyn's ankle injury is likely to sideline for multiple weeks.
items.impact: Baltimore lost two centers on Sunday with Ethan Pocic also expected to miss extended time. Rookie Vega Ioane is expected to start at center for the Ravens.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ethan Pocic (knee) expected to miss extended time
items.desc: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said C Ethan Pocic is looking at a long-term absence.
items.impact: Pocic went down with a knee injury in Sunday's loss against the Cowboys. Rookie Vega Ioane is expected to start at center for Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jameis Winston to remain Giants starting QB
items.desc: Giants coach John Harbaugh confirmed Jameis Winston remains the team's starting quarterback.
items.impact: Harbaugh confirmed this statement after the team traded for JJ McCarthy on Monday. Winston has struggled in two games, but he'll remain the team's starter for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matthew Judon signs with 49ers
items.desc: The 49ers signed DE Matt Judon.
items.impact: Judon will join the 49ers' practice squad. He will likely be elevated next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brian Burns suffers torn ACL
items.desc: Giants head coach John Harbaugh confirmed on Monday that Brian Burns suffered a torn ACL in Week 3's win over the Titans.
items.impact: It is another brutal blow for the Giants, losing a key player for the season in back-to-back weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) avoids serious injury, could play in Week 4
items.desc: NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reports Justin Jefferson's ankle injury is not "anything long-term" and that he could play in Week 4 against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said after Sunday's game that Jefferson was "close" to returning. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) considered week-to-week
items.desc: Ian Rapoport reports Breece Hall is considered week-to-week with a quad injury.
items.impact: Hall received "good news after the MRI" he received. Braelon Allen will figure to take over the lead role in the Jets backfield in his absence. He will be in the RB2/flex range for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Thompson (hamstring) to miss at least four weeks
items.desc: Cowboys EVP Stephen Jones said Jalen Thompson will miss "four-plus weeks."
items.impact: Thompson will be placed on injured reserve. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bryce Young (leg) to undergo imaging
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Bryce Young (leg) will undergo imaging "just to make sure" on Monday.
items.impact: Young took a cleat to the leg, but he was able to finish Sunday's game against the Browns. It doesn't appear to be anything too serious, but it's still worth monitoring.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Oliver to undergo surgery to repair torn biceps
items.desc: Vikings TE Josh Oliver will undergo surgery to repair a torn biceps.
items.impact: It's likely a season-ending injury for Oliver. He was primarily a blocking tight end for Minnesota.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) will not practice this week
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Micah Parsons will not practice this week.
items.impact: Parsons is not ready to return to the field quite yet. LaFleur said that Parsons has not suffered any setbacks in his recovery. His 21-day practice window can be opened at any point.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaycee Horn suffers torn quad, out indefinitely
items.desc: Panthers CB Jaycee Horn suffered a torn quad and is out indefinitely.
items.impact: Horn will seek a second opinion, but he's headed for the Injured Reserve. There is some concern he could be out for the season, a brutal loss for the Panthers defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalon Daniels set to be starter for Tampa Bay
items.desc: Jalon Daniels is set to be Tampa Bay's starting quarterback for the next three weeks at least.
items.impact: Daniels, an undrafted rookie out of Kansas, is set to be Tampa Bay's starting quarterback with Baker Mayfield (thumb) expected to miss a minimum of three weeks. He is unlikely to have any fantasy value himself, and it remains to be seen if he will play well enough to support the fantasy value of Bucky Irving and Emeka Egbuka over the next few weeks, but he will have a good opportunity to prove himself in an easy matchup against Green Bay's struggling defense in Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) expected to miss three weeks
items.desc: Baker Mayfield (thumb) is expected to be sidelined for around three weeks.
items.impact: Mayfield underwent an MRI on his thumb after Sunday's loss to the Vikings, and the results indicated that he will need to miss around three weeks while he recovers. The team is going to start undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels in his absence, which is likely bad news for the fantasy value of Emeka Egbuka, Bucky Irving, and Tampa Bay's entire offense for the next few weeks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Patriots D/ST dismal in blowout loss Sunday
items.desc: The Patriots' D/ST logged one sack and one interception while allowing 35 points in Sunday's blowout loss at the hands of the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: New England's defense was terrible on Sunday. They allowed Jacksonville to score 35 points over the course of the afternoon, and they weren't able to make any big plays to help out their own offense. This unit should not be started for the foreseeable future, especially with a tough matchup against the Bills coming up next week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andy Borregales misses field goal in loss Sunday
items.desc: Andy Borregales went 2-for-3 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: Borregales didn't have a great game on Sunday, missing one of his three field-goal attempts in the team's blowout loss at the hands of the Jaguars. If he continues to play bad, his job could be in jeopardy at some point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Williams held to one catch Sunday
items.desc: Kyle Williams caught 1-of-3 targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 35-6 blowout loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: The young wideout got on the field on Sunday and was able to haul in one 34-yard pass against the Jaguars, but he wasn't able to do anything else in the team's blowout loss. It's nice to see him actually on the field for New England, but he doesn't project to have any fantasy value for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeMario Douglas catches one pass in loss Sunday
items.desc: DeMario Douglas caught 1-of-5 targets for 38 yards in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: Douglas had a tough time connecting with QB Drake Maye on Sunday, catching just one of his five targets for a 38-yard gain. He will continue to see a solid amount of targets on a week-to-week basis moving forward but carries very little fantasy upside for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mack Hollins leads team in receiving Sunday
items.desc: Mack Hollins hauled in 6-of-9 targets for 87 yards in Sunday's 35-6 blowout loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: Hollins was one of the lone bright spots for the Patriots on Sunday. He led the team in targets, receptions, and receiving yards against the Jaguars, but that wasn't enough to even keep things close against the Jaguars. He will continue to play a big role for the Patriots moving forward but shouldn't be trusted as a fantasy option at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Hunter Henry a non-factor in loss Sunday
items.desc: Hunter Henry caught 1-of-2 targets for just five yards in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: The veteran tight end wasn't able to contribute for the Patriots on Sunday. He finished with just one five-yard catch against the Jaguars, which left him with a very poor fantasy total. He can't be trusted as a streaming option in most leagues moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Romeo Doubs underwhelming in loss Sunday
items.desc: Romeo Doubs caught 3-of-4 targets for 49 yards in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: Doubs looked good with nearly 100 yards in Week 2, but he didn't find the same success this week, catching just three passes for 49 scoreless yards in a blowout loss to the Jaguars. He isn't a reliable fantasy option at this point in the season and shouldn't be started in most leagues, even if he continues to have decent upside on a week-to-week basis.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson inefficient in loss Sunday
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed the ball seven times for 22 yards and caught three passes for 16 yards in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: Stevenson was ineffective for the Patriots on Sunday. He was only able to contribute 22 yards on the ground, and he wasn't able to do much through the air either in their blowout loss to the Jaguars. He shouldn't be started in most fantasy leagues for the foreseeable future, especially with TreVeyon Henderson seeing more carries than him this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson totals 29 yards in loss Sunday
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson rushed the ball eight times for 23 yards and caught one pass for six yards in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: New England's offense wasn't able to get anything going on Sunday, and Henderson was no exception to that. He totaled just 29 yards on nine opportunities against the Jaguars, which burned any fantasy managers who started him in this matchup. He should not be started in most leagues until New England figures out their offensive issues.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Drake Maye loses three turnovers in blowout loss Sunday
items.desc: Drake Maye completed 14-of-25 passing attempts for 199 yards and two interceptions while adding 18 yards and a lost fumble on the ground in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: Maye's nightmare start to the season continued on Sunday. He lost three turnovers over the course of the afternoon and was only able to lead the Patriots to six points in a blowout loss to the Jaguars. He is unstartable at this point in the season, and fantasy managers should be avoiding most of the fantasy options on New England's offense until they can figure things out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaguars D/ST stellar in blowout win Sunday
items.desc: The Jaguars' D/ST logged three sacks, two interceptions, and one fumble recovery while allowing just six points in Sunday's blowout win over the New England Patriots.
items.impact: Jacksonville's defense absolutely shut down the Patriots' offense on Sunday. They allowed just six points over the course of the afternoon and were able to log a number of big plays to help out their own offense. This unit has a tough matchup coming up against the Bengals next week, however, so they may not be worth starting despite their great performance this week.
